# ANALYSIS: WALK_FORWARD_OOS_REALFILLS_TOP3J

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** validation  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Running walk-forward out-of-sample (OOS) tests and real-fills replay on the top 3 J days (by absolute P&L impact: 5/04, 5/01, 5/06) will verify whether the current engine achieves edge_capture ≥ 771 (50% of max possible 1542) and keeps P&L deviation within ±20% of the J source-of-truth P&L on those days.

## Mechanism

- **Walk-forward OOS test:** Use the existing pipeline (`backtest/autoresearch/walk_forward_oos.py`) with a 12-month training window and 3-month test window, rolled forward across the full 16-month OPRA dataset, capturing engine P&L on each of the three target days.
- **Real-fills replay:** Replay the engine's decisions on the three target days using cached real OPRA fills (`backtest/data/options/SPY{YYMMDD}{C|P}{strike*1000}.csv`) with bid/ask slippage model, comparing engine P&L to J's source-of-truth P&L (+$730, +$470, -$300).
- **Edge_capture calculation:** Sum of engine P&L on the two winner days (5/04, 5/01) minus sum of max(0, engine loss) on the loser day (5/06). Compare to threshold 771.
- **P&L deviation:** For each day, compute (engine_pnl - J_pnl) / |J_pnl|; require average absolute deviation ≤ 20% across the three days.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline P&L. Analysis assumes full-size execution for edge_capture calculation.
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size = 3 J days (5/04, 5/01, 5/06). Selection method = top 3 by absolute P&L impact from J's source-of-truth. Overfit risk: high if engine tuned to these specific days; walk-forward OOS helps mitigate by testing on out-of-sample windows.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward OOS test not yet run).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real-fills replay not yet run).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day = large adverse move causing engine to miss winner or incur excess loss on loser; max drawdown scenario = consecutive losses on loser days wiping out winner gains; blow-up scenario = engine taking wrong-side trades on all three days.
6. **Concentration:** If top-3 days contribute >100% of edge_capture (possible if engine loses on other days), concentration disclosure will be provided post-test.

## Pre-merge gate

- Walk-forward OOS test must show edge_capture ≥ 771 and average P&L deviation ≤ 20% on the three target days.
- Real-fills replay must confirm the OOS results with ≤20% P&L deviation vs. BS-simulated P&L on those days.
- All gym validators (`backtest/tests/`) must pass.
- No regression on existing J-RATIFIED candidates (e.g., V14E_PARAM_SWEEP_26K, MIDDAY_TRENDLINE_GATE).

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

This analysis does not propose a change to the engine; it is a validation of current performance. If results show edge_capture ≥ 771 and ≤20% deviation, the current engine remains viable for J-rated deployment. If results fall short, it may trigger re-evaluation of candidates that modify entry/exit logic (e.g., STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND, WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE).
